key_insight: Normalizing flows can model quantum gates as transformations between phase-space probability distributions, enabling a generative approach to classical quantum circuit simulation.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a potential alternative to neural-network quantum simulators when accuracy at larger qubit counts is important.
method: Represent N-qubit states as probability distributions on a smooth 2N-dimensional manifold.
Parameterize unitary gates as normalizing flows between these distributions.
Learn phase-space representations for quantum circuit simulation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on three common circuit families and higher accuracy than current state-of-the-art neural-network methods at large system sizes.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify runtime, memory use, or training costs, so practical scaling advantages remain unclear.
paper_title: Normalizing Flows for Classical Simulation of Quantum Circuits in Phase Space
